### Photo of the month

The effect was obtained using a longer shutter speed while zooming in with my 24-120mm lens. This keeps the focal point fairly stable, while creating a cool vortex/ICM look for the edges of the frame.

![Swedish summer\
© 2026.](photos/fotm.jpg)

### Interesting things I've read/watched

Why does 'Luddite' have a negative connotation? [Brian Merchant](https://www.bloodinthemachine.com/p/understanding-the-luddites-in-the?utm_source=post-email-title&publication_id=1744395&post_id=202157698&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=false&r=5ols6&triedRedirect=true&utm_medium=email) breaks down who the Luddites were and why Luddism is important in our present.

[The Dangerous Myth of Flexibility](https://prospect.org/2026/07/09/dangerous-myth-of-flexibility-uber-lyft-gig-economy/). About the gig economy.

[The End of Reading is Here](https://www.theatlantic.com/magazine/2026/08/reading-crisis-postliterate-age/687618/). The irony is that it's a long read. Great long form essay about reading, and how we may be in a [post-literate society](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Post-literate_society).

[Article on salmon farming in Norway](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-07-28/how-norway-s-salmon-industry-became-a-global-behemoth/106949872). Pretty crazy that Norway invested a lot of marketing to sell salmon to Japan – salmon sushi was apparently not popular before this.

["Right to repair" in farming](https://www.thebignewsletter.com/p/youll-own-nothing-and-be-happy-why?utm_source=post-email-title&publication_id=11524&post_id=206296640&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=false&r=5ols6&triedRedirect=true&utm_medium=email).

[Excellent video essay](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=elC-VEg5IiI) about how concentrated the seed supply is in modern agriculture, and why we should support local organic farmers.

[The richest country is pretty mid now](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4FZy1lBNykA).
